{{Intro/Resonator|lang=zh=心}} She is also known as "The Moon Fox" or Hsin (Heart), and is one of [[Huanglong|Huanglong's]] seven [[Sentinel]]s who is located in [[Mengzhou]].

As per the tale of "The Fox and the Moon", one of the most popular origin stories of the [[Moon-Chasing Festival]], Hsin is a merrymaker among the Sentinels known for her love of merriment and mischief, and once teased another Sentinel with a night of chasing during celebration. This joyous scene, as they were silhouetted against the mid-autumn moonlight, gave rise to the term "Moon-Chasing."
